Product Features

  • The mattress has 406 springs and is made up of 2 layers of foam that are not only soft but also supportive and comfortable. We use non-toxic textiles that have been tested according to Oeko-Tex Standard 100 and are safe and non-allergenic!
  • DESIGNER HEADBED: The bed and headboard are upholstered in grey linen fabric to give a warm and comfortable feeling, and the design panel of the headboard with grill matches the warm, rustic style of your home.
  • PRACTICAL DESIGN WITH READING LIGHT: The reading lamp at the head of the bed is perfectly positioned and provides pleasant light without disturbing your partner. The flexible orientation allows you to direct the light exactly where you need it so that you can read in peace.
  • BUILT-IN CHARGING FUNCTION: There is a USB socket at the bottom of the reading light to charge electronic devices such as mobile phones and tablets, you no longer need to get up to charge your devices, saving you time and energy.
  • DURABLE: You can be sure that you are investing in a piece of furniture that will last. The main frame is made of iron to ensure the stability of the bed with a load capacity of 330 lbs. The slatted frame is made of durable solid wood slats that provide comfortable support while sleeping.
  • GAS STRUT BED DESIGN: Huge storage space, large bed base under the folding slatted base, plenty of storage space for blankets, pillows or sheets, the bed base is easy to fold with the lifting cylinder. An Oxford cloth is attached to the bottom of the bed to keep dust out.
  • DETAILED INFORMATION: This bed is available in different materials and sizes: natural beige linen and grey flannel, as well as in three sizes 90*200cm/140*200cm/160*200cm. To reduce the risk of damage, this bed frame is shipped in 3 boxes that can arrive on different days. If all three packages have arrived but parts are missing, please contact customer service.
